1.asv: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

2.web: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
2.asv: If one assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

3.web: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
3.asv: Behold, thou hast instructed many, And thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

4.web: Your words have supported him who was falling, You have made firm the feeble knees.
4.asv: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, And thou hast made firm the feeble knees.

5.web: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.
5.asv: But now it is come unto thee, and thou faintest; It toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

6.web: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
6.asv: Is not thy fear of God thy confidence, Andthe integrity of thy ways thy hope?

7.web: “Remember, now, whoever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
7.asv: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

8.web: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity, and sow trouble, reap the same.
8.asv: According as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, And sow trouble, reap the same.

9.web: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
9.asv: By the breath of God they perish, And by the blast of his anger are they consumed.

10.web: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
10.asv: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

11.web: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
11.asv: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, And the whelps of the lioness are scattered abroad.

12.web: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
12.asv: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, And mine ear received a whisper thereof.

13.web: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
13.asv: In thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falleth on men,

14.web: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
14.asv: Fear came upon me, and trembling, Which made all my bones to shake.

15.web: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.
15.asv: Then a spirit passed before my face; The hair of my flesh stood up.

16.web: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,
16.asv: It stood still, but I could not discern the appearance thereof; A form was before mine eyes: There wassilence, and I heard a voice, saying,

17.web: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
17.asv: Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

18.web: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
18.asv: Behold, he putteth no trust in his servants; And his angels he chargeth with folly:

19.web: How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
19.asv: How much more them that dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, Who are crushed before the moth!

20.web: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.
20.asv: Betwixt morning and evening they are destroyed: They perish for ever without any regarding it.

21.web: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
21.asv: Is not their tent-cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.
